scripts.build: pnpm run build:desktop && pnpm run build:chrome && pnpm run build:firefox
scripts.lint: biome check server/src/ desktop/src/ extensions/shared/src/ extensions/chrome/src/ extensions/firefox/src/
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write server/src/ desktop/src/ extensions/shared/src/ extensions/chrome/src/ extensions/firefox/src/
scripts.format: biome format --write server/src/ desktop/src/ extensions/shared/src/ extensions/chrome/src/ extensions/firefox/src/
scripts.type-check: pnpm -C server run type-check && pnpm -C desktop run type-check && pnpm -C extensions/chrome run type-check && pnpm -C extensions/firefox run type-check
scripts.release:extensions: pnpm version:check && pnpm icons:check && pnpm build:chrome && pnpm build:firefox && pnpm package:chrome && pnpm package:firefox
